name: MySQL Server
description: Installs MySQL Community Server (8.4 LTS by default) inside the container via Oracle's APT repository, persists data via a named volume, and starts mysqld on container start through a shared services dispatcher.

version.description: MySQL version. '8.4' (LTS, supported to 2032), '8.0', or innovation track '9.x'.

rootPassword.description: Empty (default) leaves root authenticated via unix_socket — recommended for dev. Set a string to use password auth.

createDatabase.description: Optional initial database to create on first boot.

createUser.description: Optional initial user to create with ALL PRIVILEGES on createDatabase.
